brief:
Israeli occupation forces continued violating the ceasefire agreement in Gaza on Saturday through bombing, demolition operations, and gunfire targeting scattered areas across the territory, Shehab Wire reported. The violations included sustained strikes on multiple locations within the enclave as fighting persisted despite the supposed halt to hostilities.

The breaches occurred across different parts of the strip, with Israeli forces conducting bombardment campaigns and demolition work throughout the day. Gunfire also remained active in various sectors, according to reports of the ongoing violations.
